description: This file defines serializable data structures and methods related to Orleans silo registration with Consul. It includes classes for representing silo registration data and suspect silo information, as well as methods for converting between Consul KV pairs and Orleans membership entries, with a focus on serializing/deserializing these objects for Consul storage.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistration
classes.description: A JSON-serializable class representing the registration info of a silo for Consul consistency, including properties like hostname, port, status, and suspect list.

classes.name: SuspectingSilo
classes.description: A class representing a silo suspected of issues, including ID and timestamp.

methods.name: FormatVersionKey
methods.description: Constructs the key for versioning in Consul KV storage for a deployment.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentKVPrefix
methods.description: Builds the prefix for deployment keys in Consul KV store, optionally including root folder.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentSiloKey
methods.description: Generates the key for a specific silo based on deployment ID and address.

methods.name: FormatSiloIAmAliveKey
methods.description: Creates the key used for IAmAlive heartbeat for a specific silo.

methods.name: FromKVPairs
methods.description: Converts Consul KV pairs into a ConsulSiloRegistration object, including deserialization and address parsing.

methods.name: FromMembershipEntry
methods.description: Creates a ConsulSiloRegistration object from an Orleans MembershipEntry for synchronization with Consul.

methods.name: ToKVPair
methods.description: Serializes a ConsulSiloRegistration into a Consul KV pair for storage in Consul.

methods.name: ToIAmAliveKVPair
methods.description: Creates a KV pair representing a silo's heartbeat timestamp.

methods.name: ToMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a ConsulSiloRegistration back into an Orleans MembershipEntry for internal use.
